high_level_description: The image features two book covers side by side, each belonging to a former Army Chief of the Indian Army. The left cover is for "Four Stars of Destiny: An Autobiography" by General Manoj Mukund Naravane, while the right cover is for "Alone in the Ring: Decision-Making in Critical Times" by General N.C.
